pick.headline: New Jewel Movement seizes power in Grenada
pick.summary: On 13 March 1979 Maurice Bishop's New Jewel Movement overthrew Prime Minister Eric Gairy while he was abroad.
pick.significance: The revolutionary government aligned with Cuba, and its collapse in 1983 led to the US invasion of Grenada.
